status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: Round 1 (ADR 0096) results are known (all NOT_PROMISING). None of the series below (market beta, downside beta, coskewness, price delay, volatility-managed index) has been computed by this archive on alts; the daily klines are already spent by earlier ADRs.
requested_by: 동동, 2026-11-20 '기준을 통과하는 전략이 나올때까지 계속 돌려 멈추지 말고'. Round 2 of that loop.

already_tested_not_repeated: LOWVOL30 total volatility (0035/0047), idio vol R3 (0051), MAX (0040), residual signals (0051), regime classifiers (0044/0050), round 1 (0096)
new_here: volatility-managed alt index (Moreira-Muir): time-varying exposure of the EW U50 long by inverse 30-day realised vol
betting against beta: market beta rank (not total or idio volatility)
downside beta (Ang-Chen-Xing) and coskewness (Harvey-Siddique) as risk-premium ranks
price delay (Hou-Moskowitz): how slowly a coin absorbs market moves, lagged-market R2 share

scope: DEV only. No criteria change. A DEV_PROMISING flag only leads to a report to the user.
universe: exactly ADR 0047/0094/0096 (U50 ranks 1..50, W200 ranks 1..200 by 30-day mean quote volume >= 2M USDT, >=60 bars, cut-off bar i-2)
market_series: m_t = equal-weight mean daily close-to-close return of the names of the current universe (U50 for U50 trials, W200 for W200 trials) at the rebalance, over the lookback days with returns available

segments.rebalance: every 14 days on the Monday grid (anchors 2021-03-01, 2024-08-19); trade at open of day i; weights drift; real funding

lookback: 90 daily returns ending at cut (>= 60 valid per name, else no signal)

trials.VM1_VOLMANAGED_U50: long every U50 name equally, total gross = min(2.0, 0.60 / annualised stdev of m over cut-29..cut); no short leg
trials.BAB_BETA_U50: OLS beta of r_i on m; quintile long-short, long the LOWEST beta
trials.DB_DOWNBETA_U50: beta of r_i on m using only days with m < 0 (>= 25 such days); long the HIGHEST
trials.CSK_COSKEW_U50: mean((r-mean r)(m-mean m)^2) / (sd r * var m); long the LOWEST (most negative)
trials.DLY_DELAY_U50: D1 = 1 - R2(r ~ m_t) / R2(r ~ m_t + m_t-1 + m_t-2 + m_t-3 + m_t-4); long the HIGHEST delay

cost: ADR 0041 calibrated cost 'cal' decides; cal_x2, cal_tail_x2 conditions; cost0 reference
decision_rule: identical to ADR 0094/0096: S1 SR > expected max of 6 null trials, alpha t >= 2 vs EW U50 market, both S1 halves > 0, S2 > 0.5, S1 > 0 under cal_x2 and cal_tail_x2; also reported DSR at N=6 and cumulative N, PBO CSCV-16 over the 6 S1 series, null max at cumulative N
power_note_written_before_results: about 64 S1 rebalances over 2.4 years; minimum detectable annual SR at 80% power (Bonferroni 0.05/6) about 2.1; cumulative-N null max about 2.5.
after_result: Variants are new trials needing a new prereg. Trial count +6 regardless.
